[E] DiagramEditService: edits and resolution
|-- openCanvasContext(savedSnapshot)
|   `-- Bind live editing to durable history
|-- edit(contextId, operation)
|   |-- Resolve current diagram state
|   |-- Apply content / metadata / link change
|   |-- Match surviving logical nodes
|   |-- Validate mappings and reconcile affected references
|   |-- Persist new DiagramRevision
|   |-- Persist canvas checkpoint selecting that revision
|   `-- Advance context head; notify renderer
|-- Canvas-only edit
|   |-- Controller computes layout / connection change
|   `-- Persist checkpoint reusing unchanged diagram revisions
|-- checkpoint / restore
|   |-- Coordinate diagram bindings and canvas state
|   `-- Retain old branches after undo followed by another edit
`-- DiagramResolver.forContext(contextId).get(diagramId)
    |-- Read context's current snapshot
    |-- Resolve private diagram binding
    |-- Return content, source context and logical references
    |-- Original canvas edits use its live context
    |-- Completed edits persist before publication
    |-- Ordinary editing does not invoke publication-time merge
    `-- Camera motion / selection do not create content revisions

[F] Forked contexts: ChangeSession and alternatives
|-- DiagramEditService.forkContext(sourceContext)
|   |-- Freeze baseline including current working edits
|   |-- Create independent context sharing that baseline
|   `-- Service owns copy-on-write state and durable checkpoints
|-- ChangeSessionService
|   |-- ChangeSessionDocument
|   |   |-- baseline / proposal context references
|   |   |-- changes and dependencies
|   |   `-- decisions and application receipts
|   |-- Agent edits -> DiagramEditService.edit(proposalContext)
|   |-- Preview -> resolver for proposalContext
|   |-- Explorer -> Accept / Reject each change
|   |-- Toolbar -> Accept all / Reject all
|   |   |-- Accept all -> pending only; preserve rejections
|   |   `-- Reject all -> pending only [proposed symmetry]
|   `-- Apply accepted changes
|       |-- Exclude rejected / pending changes
|       |-- Validate dependencies and reviewed versions
|       |-- Reset review if relevant payload/dependency changes
|       `-- DiagramEditService.publish(selected changes)
`-- CanvasAlternativesService
    |-- Generate candidates from frozen original baseline
    |-- One context per candidate; same diagramId
    |-- Separate preview canvas resolver per candidate
    |-- Refine -> DiagramEditService.edit(candidateContext)
    |-- Use candidate -> DiagramEditService.publish(candidate)
    |-- Alternatives do not belong to DiagramChangeSession
    `-- Unselected candidates remain isolated
